run_train_tourist: run the tourist language model training on the TalkTheWalk dataset with configurable epochs and batch size
run_eval_epoch: run eval_epoch to compute average loss over a data loader with optional backpropagation
create_tourist_model: create a TouristLanguage model with action, observation, and decoder embedding dimensions
review_eval_epoch: review the eval_epoch function that computes loss and optionally performs gradient descent steps
refactor_train_tourist: refactor the training loop to support early stopping or learning rate scheduling
